description: 1. Agent must read /workspace/raw_news_input.json to get the 5 real news items. 2. Agent must locate the proprietary script at /root/.openclaw/workspace/skills/ai-news-xiaohongshu/scripts/create-xiaohongshu-content.js by reading SKILL.md. 3. Agent must understand the --news-json CLI flag and the required JSON schema (title, content, url, time, source fields) — this is the proprietary trap, as a naive agent may try to build a custom script or use wrong field names. 4. Agent must pass the news data via the --news-json argument (not --use-demo), so the script processes real data. 5. The script automatically creates output/YYYY-MM-DD-NN/ directory inside the skill root and generates all 4 files: xiaohongshu-copy.md, cover.html, news-summary.md, sources.md. 6. The cover.html must be 3:4 ratio (1080x1440px), have 1-3 page screens with a divider between them. 7. The xiaohongshu-copy.md must have emoji, hashtags, and avoid forbidden AI-sounding transition words. 8. All files must reflect the real news content (Anthropic, DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemini, ByteDance), not demo data.
